title: Split and merge by reasoning obligation rather than length
prompt:
我明确确认本次范围没有 paper-decisions.md 或其他未提供的先前决策历史。

请重组下面两个英文段落。第一个过密，第二个过碎；不要套固定句数，并保留全部有依据的信息。

Dense: EdgeKV serves read-heavy edge workloads, but intermittent links make global invalidation expensive. It partitions keys by region. Each partition uses a 2 s lease. In a 24-site trace replay, leases reduced invalidation messages by 31% relative to eager invalidation. Writes may remain invisible outside a partition until the lease expires, so the result does not preserve eager visibility. The implementation also uses Rust.

Sparse: Device failures interrupt compaction. Recovery replays a journal. The journal contains committed segment identifiers. Replay was tested after process crashes.

dense_relations: intermittent links make global invalidation expensive
31 percent fewer invalidation messages in a 24-site trace replay versus eager invalidation
visibility can lag until lease expiry
sparse_relations: recovery replays a journal of committed segment identifiers
replay tested after process crashes only

forbidden_actions: apply a fixed paragraph or sentence count
hard_gates: All protected propositions and tokens survive.
The dense material is separated by reasoning role rather than arbitrary length.
The sparse material is connected without broadening process-crash evidence.
expected_behavior: Separate motivation/design from result/boundary when that improves inferential closure.
Keep Rust as implementation status without pretending it explains the result.
Merge sparse fragments into a causal recovery account.
End each resulting paragraph on a supported implication or boundary.

rubric.criterion: Returns revised English prose before process commentary.
Preserves regional partitioning and the 2 s lease.
Keeps delayed visibility as a limitation adjacent to the result.
Preserves Rust without assigning it unsupported causal importance.
Connects device-failure interruption to journal replay coherently.
Bounds tested recovery to process crashes.
Does not enforce or announce a fixed sentence count.
Resulting paragraph boundaries coincide with distinct reasoning obligations.
No new mechanism, result, or neighboring-section transition is invented.
